<!-- Search existing issues before submitting. Keep each request focused on one improvement. -->

## Problem or use case

Describe what you are trying to accomplish and where the current workflow falls short. Who would benefit, and how often does this come up?

## Proposed behavior

Describe how the feature should work from the user's perspective. Include an example involving playlist selection, duplicate matching, Keep choices, playback, removal, or another relevant workflow.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any workaround you use today or other approaches that could solve the problem.

## Playlist and library impact

<!-- Complete this section if the request changes matching or removal behavior; otherwise write N/A. -->

Describe which songs should match, which playlist entries should stay or be removed, and how users would review the changes before applying them. Include any effect on locked playlists or the Music library itself.

<!--
Today, duplicates are the same Music library item (database ID) appearing in at
least two selected playlists. Removals affect playlist entries only and preserve
the library song. Smart, Genius, and system playlists cannot be edited by the app.
Use this context to explain any proposed change to those behaviors.
-->

## What would make this complete?

List the observable results that would satisfy this request.

- Describe a success criterion here.

## Additional context

Add optional sketches, screenshots, or examples. Include your app and macOS versions if the request depends on them.
